Our Purpose

At Teradyne, we empower innovation through advanced test and automation solutions that enable our customers to bring high-quality semiconductor products to market faster. We are committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences through collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous innovation.

 

Opportunity Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Field Application Engineer (FAE) to support customers across Israel. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with semiconductor manufacturers, design teams, and internal engineering organizations to deploy, optimize, and support ATE solutions.

The successful candidate will leverage technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and strong communication abilities to help customers achieve production goals and maximize the value of Teradyne test platforms. This position is ideal for an experienced engineer with a solid background in semiconductor test, device characterization, production support, and customer engagement.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support and applications expertise for Teradyne ATE platforms.
  • Support customer evaluations, installations, and production ramp activities.
  • Develop and debug test programs for semiconductor devices.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, and test-related issues in customer environments.
  • Work closely with customer engineering teams to optimize test performance, yield, throughput, and quality.
  • Deliver technical training and knowledge transfer to customers.
  • Collaborate with Product Engineering, R&D, Marketing, and Sales teams to resolve complex technical challenges.
  • Identify opportunities for product improvements and communicate customer requirements to internal stakeholders.
  • Participate in customer meetings, project reviews, and product demonstrations.
  • Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction through responsive and professional support.

 

About You

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience of semiconductor testing Industry (ATE) and hands on experience on IC component testing project development 
  • Must have Test / Product engineering experience in Digital, High-Speed Digital, High-Power Computing, System on Chip, Mixed Signal, or Analog testing and test development on ATE (Automated Test Equipment) platforms. 
  • Experience with semiconductor test development, characterization, debug, and production support.
  • Strong understanding of semiconductor devices, test methodologies, and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex hardware and software issues.
  • Ability to analyze data and drive effective technical solutions.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Willingness to travel within Israel and occasionally internationally 25%, as required.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Teradyne test platforms and semiconductor test ecosystems.
  • Knowledge of mixed-signal, analog, RF, or SoC testing.
  • Familiarity with programming and scripting languages used in test development.
  • Experience working directly with semiconductor customers in a field-facing role.

 

Success Profile

The ideal candidate is a customer-focused engineering professional who demonstrates strong technical acumen, effective collaboration skills, and the ability to independently solve complex challenges. This role aligns well with a fully qualified, experienced engineering professional capable of working on diverse technical issues and providing effective solutions while collaborating with customers and internal teams.

We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position.
